session_selection._description: Mandatory parameters have no weight or rating: every condition must pass, including data availability. Relative parameters contribute normalised weights; 0 disables a preference. Missing relative data uses unknown_condition_score. All-mandatory selection has no numeric rating.

astronomical_night._description: Sun at/below -18 degrees when mandatory. Relative mode rates night above astronomical twilight, down to planning_rules.darkness.maximum_sun_altitude.

altitude._description: Mandatory: at/above chart.minimum_altitude_deg and the absolute planning minimum. Relative: higher average altitude earns preference.

horizon._description: Actual horizon obstruction always excludes capture. Mandatory: also require planning_rules.visibility.horizon_clearance_margin. Relative: score that clearance margin.

integration._description: Mandatory: meet planning_rules.integration.minimum_minutes and minimum_exposures. Relative: compare complete exposure counts after overheads.

transit._description: Mandatory: include the target transit. Relative: favour windows containing or close to transit.

moon._description: Mandatory: complete Moon data and effective interference no greater than maximum_interference (0 means none). Relative: average Moon penalty, adjusted for dual-band sensitivity.

cloud._description: Mandatory: complete cloud data and no point above maximum_percent. Relative: decreasing preference above cloud_forecast.clear_max_percent; missing data remains unknown.

precipitation._description: Mandatory: complete forecast and no probability above maximum_percent. Relative: prefer lower precipitation probability.

start_time._description: Non-automated relative mode progressively favours earlier eligible dark time, with additional late/early-hours penalties. Automated sessions ignore this relative preference. Mandatory: start within the normal hours in planning_rules.timing.

fits_browser._description: Chosen folder is depth 0; allow three child-folder levels. If any real subfolder exceeds the limit, reject the entire scan before reading FITS metadata. Directory symlinks are skipped.

_notes: Active application configuration. Sidebar changes update their own scalar fields while preserving all other sections.
